_comment: The recorded pinned-build baseline arm for the qa-gen.publish empty-slot invariant. Produced via WF-345's pinned-build install option: the pre-slot qa-gen build installed as the run source. Carries the pinned build's fingerprint and the run fingerprints of the baseline set. CANNED per item.md's disclosure — Docker + CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN are unavailable in this environment; the run bytes are shaped exactly like the WF-345 runner's output tree, and runner/run-skill.sh regenerates them from the real pinned build when a container and token are available.

pinned_build.description: the qa-gen skill immediately before the qa-gen.publish composition point was introduced

provenance.reason: Docker and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN are both absent in the authoring/CI environment (the same constraint WF-345/WF-346/WF-347 hit), so the pinned pre-slot build was not re-installed and executed in a live container. The run bytes are shaped exactly like the WF-345 runner output tree; runner/run-skill.sh regenerates them from the real pinned build when a container and token are available, and the comparison re-runs unchanged. Disclosed in this item .md under "Canned-vs-real disclosure".
